in_hebrew.name: Bogusław
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Bogusław הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Old Polish word ‘Bog’, meaning ‘God’, and ‘slaw’, meaning ‘glory’ or ‘fame’. The name Bogusław honors God and signifies the glory or fame that comes from a life devoted to Him.

in_latin.name: Boguslaus
